name: ai-pm-os
description: A product manager's AI workflow, packaged as installable Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: proof-before-done
plugins.description: Hooks that ask once for a read-back before the agent may claim an external write (chat, docs, email, sheets) is done, plus a backtest and a self-correct skill.

plugins.name: operating-rules
plugins.description: Opt-in session rules: a compact version of the eight operating rules, injected at the start of every session.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: A skill that keeps one lean, always-current STATUS.md so you can /clear and the next session resumes by reading a single file.

plugins.name: knowledge-compounding
plugins.description: A skill that turns explanations from your sessions into a cross-linked, diagrammed markdown knowledge base, captured by a background agent that never interrupts the answer.

plugins.name: product-workflows
plugins.description: Three skills for a product manager's core loop: evidence-first market research, a PRD with a clean shareable copy, and a decision ledger that logs bets and reviews them without inventing answers.

plugins.name: pm-routines
plugins.description: Three scheduled routines that interview you before their first run, then tighten themselves over time: market-sweep (social, community and ad platforms), weekly-metrics-review (KR scoreboard plus an accountability audit) and watch-until (tell me once when X becomes true).
